description: Use when the request concerns the caller's own linked brokerage book. Not for a book typed into the conversation (use riskmodels_analyze_portfolio or riskmodels_portfolio_exposure). Returns the caller's positions from their default riskmodels.net portfolio (Alpaca Connect, Connect Trade or Plaid): ticker, quantity, market value and weight of each position, has_shorts, and the same book in three shapes: for_analysis (positive weights), for_hedge (positive dollar values) and for_exposure (signed dollars, short < 0). Returns an empty book when no brokerage is linked. Read-only; it does not place orders. Positions are as of the portal's last brokerage sync. Free (no REST charge). No inputs.
name: riskmodels_get_my_positions
title: RiskModels linked brokerage positions
